note: Countries a person can CREATE AN ACCOUNT from. This is NOT the list of places you can call — that is ~218 destinations and comes from the live rate card. The two are different constraints and must never be conflated: signup is limited by where Stripe supports the merchant-of-record relationship, calling is limited by what Twilio can reach.
warning: Hand-synced. The Flutter app is the source of truth and this repo cannot import from it. If supportedCountries changes and this file does not, the site tells people they can sign up when they cannot — which costs a 1-star review, not a bounce. Re-sync on any change to that list.
